title: the minimal approach to online efl classes in a low-resourced school context
core_idea: To investigate the understudied lived realities of EFL teaching in a low-resourced private school and examine a minimal-tool approach to online instruction during emergency-driven shifts from offline to online, using a phenomenological case study of six teachers with interviews, recorded classes, and document analysis analyzed via IPA.
tldr: Study explores how EFL teachers in a low-resourced Bangladeshi private school experience and enact a minimal approach to emergency online teaching, using semi-structured interviews, recorded classes, document review, and IPA analysis.
